name: dynamic storage tracks returned callable aliases
source: function make(xs: {x: number}[]): () => {x: number}[] { return () => xs; } function main(): void { const xs: {x: number}[] = []; const read = make(xs); const exposed: any = read(); const original: any = new Function("return {x: 7}")(); exposed[0] = original; console.log(xs[0] === original, read()[0] === original); }
